event.quote: I don't know what to do
event.text: Do you have any thoughts or plans about harming yourself, or access to anything you might use to hurt yourself?
event.why: Understanding intent, specificity of planning, and access to means is critical for immediate safety assessment and determining the appropriate level of care.

event.text: Please call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline) now for immediate support and a safety check — don't wait for a reply here. If you are about to act on these thoughts, or cannot keep yourself safe right now, call 911. Alongside that, I recommend a Counsel clinician review in this thread today for risk assessment and safety planning. Weeks of hopelessness plus last night's thought deserve prompt, careful attention. You don't have to sort this out alone.
